propositions: The shipped per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (22 criteria × 20 requests = 440 worst case) and wall-clock cost while discarding verified work from primary runs on failure.

Replace per-criterion fan-out with banked incremental verification: primary records criterion verdicts as sufficient evidence accrues; on typed failure, successor runs cover only unbanked remainder in batches keyed on resolved model class (standard ≤8, frontier ≤12).

Pool arithmetic reworks as function of criteria count c: verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8c, 48, 480), N = ceil(floor/2), global pool = 1.5×N, successor pool = global − primary spend; for c=8: N=32 pool=48; for c≥60: N=240 pool=360.

Criteria-scaled primary step floor (lever 1) replaces flat 480: measures show 8-criteria ticket converges at ~100 calls with floor 50 (0/3 runaway) but hits runaway 3/3 at floor 480; scaling reduces budget manufacture and recovery frequency.

Path-normalized read_file memo (lever 2) caches whole-file content on first read, serves all ranges from cache; measured 48 reads on 11 files with 77% re-read waste now collapses to 1 actual read per path per run.

Finalizer always emits full-coverage verdict when any criteria banked: verified criteria scored from banked evidence, unverified as met=false placeholders; deterministic no-LLM fallback on finalizer failure closes the verdict-less trap and sets certifiable=false.
